name: ftw-studio-drop-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker that ingests Studio Drop artwork into R2 behind Cloudflare Access.

scripts.test: node test/etsy.test.mjs && node test/queue.test.mjs && node test/routing.test.mjs
scripts.pretest: esbuild src/etsy.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=test/etsy.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/queue.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=test/queue.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/index.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning
